title: Regional Security Lead (North East)
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Job Purpose The Regional Security Lead ensures that our mission never stops. You are the guardian of our physical spaces, ensuring that every Moniepoint office is a sanctuary where our team can build and create without worry. By leading regional security operations, managing on-ground teams, and proactively identifying risks, you provide the stability and safety that allows financial happiness to thrive. You don't just react to incidents; you build the systems that prevent them. Key Responsibilities Safeguard our People and Assets: Lead the implementation of security policies that protect our team, offices, and equipment across your region. Master the Environment: Conduct regular security assessments to spot vulnerabilities and design innovative strategies to reduce risk. Lead the Front Line: Supervise and mentor private security guards and armed police personnel, ensuring they perform their duties with mastery and respect. Build Strong Alliances: Act as our primary liaison with law enforcement and emergency services, ensuring we always have a seat at the table during emergencies. Investigate and Solve: Lead the response to security breaches and accidents, providing clear, factual reports that help us learn and improve. Empower the Team: Design and deliver training programs that equip our security personnel and employees with life-saving protocols. Innovate for Safety: Stay ahead of security trends and technology (like CCTV and access control) to keep our regional operations modern and resilient. Support Business Resilience: Provide expert guidance on asset recovery and fraud investigation when the business needs your mastery. Qualifications Professional Background: Should have at least 5 years of experience successfully leading a security team in a guard services/physical security company or have 5 years of experience as an ex-commissioned service personnel supervisor—either in the military, police, or paramilitary. Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Psychology, Criminal Justice, or a related field. Certification: You hold a recognized security certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO. Integrity: A clean criminal record and the ability to pass a comprehensive background check are essential. Language & Culture: You speak the local dialects of the major tribes in your assigned region, allowing you to connect with the community. Good experience working with automated security systems like CCTV cameras, burglary alarm systems, etc. About You You are a Hero: You are driven by mastery and the desire to protect others. People count on you to come through when things get tough. You are Relatable: You don’t hide behind technical jargon. You communicate clearly and build trust with everyone, from the security guards to the executive team. You are Proactive: You don’t wait for things to go wrong. You have the "Creator" spirit, always looking for better ways to secure our future.  You are composed: In high-pressure situations, you are the calmest person in the room. You lead with facts, not emotions. What Success Looks Like Zero Preventable Incidents: Our regional offices remain safe, secure, and fully operational. High Readiness: Security personnel are well-trained and respond to drills or real-world events with 100% precision. Strong Community Ties: You have built a network of local stakeholders that helps Moniepoint navigate regional risks effectively. Operational Excellence: Security technology is 100% functional, and documentation is factual, honest, and actionable. What we can offer you Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all voices are heard, and we look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning: We have a learning- and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training. Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, plus other benefits. What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter. An interview with the hiring team. An interview with a member of our executive team. Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Job Summary We are seeking an experienced SRE to engineer the reliability of our highly distributed platform. You will combine deep knowledge of distributed systems with strong coding skills to define SLOs, lead incident response, and build automation and self-healing mechanisms into our systems. You will balance immediate operational stability with long-term strategic engineering to ensure our services scale linearly with our hyper-growth. Partner with Product Engineering teams during the design phase to ensure new services are built with reliability, scalability, and observability patterns (circuit breakers, rate limiting, backpressure, fallback strategies) from day one. Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and design patterns. Extensive experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud providers (AWS/Azure). You are proficient in running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE/EKS) and troubleshooting cluster/infrastructure issues. Experience designing observability strategies using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, New Relic, Datadog, or SigNoz to improve system visibility. Familiarity with operating and tuning production data stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) in a high-throughput environment. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in networking, cloud infrastructure, security, and automation with the leadership capability to coach a team, enforce SOPs, and drive measurable operational excellence, including leveraging AI tools to optimise how the team works. This role sits at the Team Lead level in Moniepoint's Talent Architecture. Success is defined not only by personal technical output, but by the team's consistent performance and delivery against infrastructure-wide targets. Scope & Decision Horizon Leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. Success is the orchestration of people and priorities to ensure the team's immediate output aligns with the broader roadmap. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Team Leadership & Operations Lead, coordinate, and coach a team of Systems Administrators, ensuring consistent output quality and adherence to SOPs. Manage team workload, prioritise tasks across competing demands, and ensure SLA compliance across all infrastructure functions. Conduct regular 1:1s, deliver direct and specific performance feedback, and actively develop team members' technical skills. Design and enforce team workflows and escalation paths, ensuring quality is consistent regardless of who executes the task. Own team-level metrics: system uptime (99.9%+), ticket SLAs, incident response times, and end-user satisfaction. Identify gaps in team capability or process and proactively close them through training, tooling, or workflow redesign. Infrastructure Management Design, implement, and maintain a robust IT infrastructure, including servers and virtualisation platforms (Proxmox). Administer and optimise Windows Server, Linux systems, and hybrid cloud infrastructures. Maintain comprehensive system documentation, network diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Plan and execute system upgrades with minimal downtime; optimise for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Administer and optimise BGP routing policies, virtual routers (vRTF), and F5 load balancers across the enterprise network and cloud environments. Implement and maintain network security protocols, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation across on-premise and cloud environments. Manage DNS, DHCP, Directory as a Service, and other core network services. Monitor network performance, analyse bandwidth utilisation, and implement QoS policies. Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n and similar platforms to optimise repetitive operational processes. Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for network deployment, incident triage, and infrastructure monitoring. Coach team members on responsible AI integration, when to use AI tools, how to validate outputs, and where human review is required. Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil through intelligent automation and continuously improve the team's automation capabilities. At least 2 years of formal or informal team leadership, including coaching, delegation, and performance feedback. Cloud networking expertise across GCP, OCI, and Azure: VPCs, subnets, load balancers, private service connect, VPN gateways, and cloud firewall management. Deep understanding of TCP/IP, BGP routing protocols, switching, VLANs, and enterprise network architecture across data centre and WAN environments. Hands-on experience with virtual routers (vRTF), F5 load balancers, and enterprise networking equipment (Cisco, Ubiquiti). Virtualisation experience with Proxmox; data centre operations including rack and stack, power, cooling, and structured cabling. Experience administering xCALLY PBX or equivalent enterprise telephony/unified communications platforms. Proficiency in scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash; experience with Ansible and Terraform. Hands-on experience with n8n or equivalent workflow automation platforms for building and managing operational automations. Experience managing AI tools within an IT environment, including access control, integration, and responsible use governance. Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, PRTG) and endpoint/MDM management platforms. Proficiency in Google Workspace administration: user and group management, Drive, Gmail, Meet, and third-party app integrations. Advanced infosec tooling experience (e.g., CrowdStrike); knowledge of Disaster Recovery protocols and DR drills. Experience with Jira Service Management; understanding of SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs.
